listing.displayName: The Orbiting Spoon - A Space Diner & Officer Social Mod
listing.summary: The Orbiting Spoon is a lightweight, text-based roleplay and campaign layer mod that adds interactive space diners to markets and spaceports across the Persean Sector.
listing.aiSummary: Adds interactive space diners to markets and spaceports, offering faction-specific meals and social interactions.

description: Adds interactive space diners to markets and spaceports across the sector. Players can order regional food and drinks that adapt to the controlling faction. Future updates plan to include officer bonding mechanics and subtle buffs from meals.
